summary: The note describes the Constitution of the Free State of Bavaria, which sets out the state's status as a land of the Federal Republic of Germany. It states that the National Assembly decided on the constitution on 26 October 1946, and that it took effect after a Council of Ministers statement on 4 December and publication in the Bavarian law gazette on 8 December 1946.
one_line: The Bavarian Constitution, adopted by the National Assembly in 1946, defines Bavaria's status as a land of Germany and entered into force in December 1946.
key_facts: The Constitution of the Free State of Bavaria regulates the independence of the Free State as a land of the Federal Republic of Germany.
The National Assembly decided on the Constitution on 26 October 1946.
The Council of Ministers issued a statement on 4 December 1946 concerning the Constitution.
The Constitution was published in the Bavarian law-paper on 8 December 1946.
The Constitution came into force upon its publication on 8 December 1946.
